audit.whatIsWrong: Lane text states twice that Mel 'has no hard CC' and nothing to stop your all-in.
audit.why: Solar Snare (E, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, 1000 range) roots at its centre and slows around it — that root ends Heroic Swing and cuts a Comeuppance channel. The lane is a poke lane you win, but not a CC-free one.
audit.corrected: She has one hard CC: Solar Snare's root on a ~10s cooldown. Step up on its downtime, not on hers being 'immobile'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The reflect is attributed to her ultimate across spikes, wants and whys.
audit.why: Rebuttal is her W, on 38/35/33/29/26s — a long, spendable cooldown you can bait. Golden Eclipse (R, 120/100/80s) is a global Overwhelm detonation with 25000 range, a completely different threat.
audit.corrected: Bait Rebuttal (W, 38s at rank 1) before committing; her R is a global execute off Overwhelm stacks, not a shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Her R reflects incoming projectiles' — wrong slot, and the reflect's real consequence for Akshan is understated.
audit.why: Rebuttal reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker and prevents damage. Every damaging thing Akshan has is a projectile — Dirty Fighting's shots, Avengerang, the Heroic Swing volley and Comeuppance — so firing into an up Rebuttal returns your whole kit. Golden Eclipse can then detonate Overwhelm from anywhere on the map.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal (W) reflects projectiles, and Akshan's entire damage output is projectiles — never fire anything into it; Golden Eclipse reaches you at any range.

edits.before: Comeuppance scales with her missing health, so a poked-down Mel dies to it — but only fire it when her R reflect is on cooldown, or it bounces straight back.
edits.after: Comeuppance scales with her missing health, so a poked-down Mel dies to it — but only fire it when Rebuttal (W) is on cooldown, or it reflects straight back.

edits.before: Her R reflects incoming projectiles and damage, returning both your boomerang and Comeuppance — never channel your ult into a Mel who is holding R.
edits.after: Rebuttal reflects projectiles back at you, and every shot Akshan owns is a projectile — never fire Avengerang or Comeuppance into a Mel holding W.

edits.after: Hold Comeuppance until Rebuttal (38s at rank 1) is down, then finish her bar with the missing-health scaling

edits.before: Bait or eat your boomerang and ult into her R reflect to flip the all-in
edits.after: Catch your boomerang and ult in Rebuttal and reflect them to flip the all-in

edits.before: Your second passive shot plus Avengerang out-trades her Q before she can chain enough hits to detonate Overwhelm, and she has no dash to disengage.
edits.after: Your second passive shot plus Avengerang out-trades her Q before she chains enough hits to detonate Overwhelm, and she has no dash to disengage.

edits.before: Heroic Swing comes online — you swing in, boomerang, and proc the three-hit passive shield while she has no CC to stop the trade.
edits.after: Heroic Swing comes online — swing in, boomerang, and proc the three-hit shield whenever Solar Snare's root is on cooldown.

edits.before: Comeuppance scales with her missing health and finishes her low bar — just hold it until her R reflect is down so it doesn't bounce back.
edits.after: Comeuppance scales with her missing health and finishes her low bar — just hold it until Rebuttal is down so it doesn't reflect back.

edits.before: At two items she zones with Zhonya's and her R reflect answers your burst, while you stay squishy — close it before then.
edits.after: At two items she zones with Zhonya's and Golden Eclipse detonates Overwhelm from across the map — close the game before then.

edits.before: Level 1 is hers — you have only one passive shot and a single Q, so she chips you with her ranged Q for free while you last-hit. Don't trade into that. The moment you hit 2 the lane flips: your second passive shot plus Avengerang out-damages her Q poke, and she has no dash and no hard CC to stop you stepping up. Proc your three-hit passive to land the shield, then back off before she chains enough Q hits to set up an Overwhelm detonation.
edits.after: Level 1 is hers — you have only one passive shot and a single Q, so she chips you with Radiant Volley for free while you last-hit. Don't trade into that. The moment you hit 2 the lane flips: your second passive shot plus Avengerang out-damages her poke, and she has no dash to escape the step-up. Proc your three-hit passive for the shield, then back off before she chains enough hits to set up an Overwhelm detonation.

edits.before: This is your window. With E at 3 you own levels 4-5 — swing off a wall, fire Avengerang on the way in, and proc the third-stack passive; she can't punish the range and has nothing to escape the all-in. The one rule that decides this lane: her R reflects incoming projectiles and damage, so it sends both your boomerang and your Comeuppance back at you. Bait it or wait it out, THEN commit. A poked-down Mel dies to Comeuppance's missing-health scaling the instant that reflect is on cooldown.
edits.after: This is your window. With E at 3 you own levels 4-5 — swing off a wall, fire Avengerang on the way in, and proc the third-stack passive; her only answer is Solar Snare's root, so step up when it's down. The one rule that decides this lane: Rebuttal reflects projectiles, and every shot you own is a projectile, so it returns your boomerang and your Comeuppance. Bait it or wait its 38 seconds out, THEN commit. A poked-down Mel dies to Comeuppance's missing-health scaling the instant that reflect is spent.

notes: The reflect was credited to Mel's ultimate in five separate fields; it is Rebuttal (W), 38/35/33/29/26s. Content also twice claimed she has no hard CC — Solar Snare roots. Golden Eclipse's 25000 range means her R threatens you after you leave lane.
